results.title: Hyderabad Aston Martin crash: MP’s son’s drug, alcohol tests negative; blood sample sent to FSL
results.description: Preliminary alcohol and drug tests on Andhra MP’s son Lingamaneni Sanjush were negative after the fatal Hyderabad Aston Martin crash. His blood sample has been sent for forensic examination.

results.description: Robinson and Tongue finished with eight wickets each in the match with the former receiving the player of the match award for figures of 5/51 and 3/29.

results.description: The price cuts are effective ‌on OpenAI's application programming interface, or ‌API, ⁠and are rolling out ⁠across eligible plans for credits on its agentic AI product ChatGPT Work and its coding tool ​Codex

results.title: Fifteen Years After Her Own Bronze, Ashwini Ponnappa Backs Treesa-Gayatri To Go 'Bigger' At Badminton Worlds
results.description: Ashwini Ponnappa and Jwala Gutta won India's last women's doubles medal at the Worlds in 2011. Fifteen years on, Treesa-Gayatri have matched that, reaching the semifinals, while Satwik-Chirag's bid ended in the quarterfinals. Ponnappa tells Outlook India she wants the pair to go bigger and better

results.title: Ganjam leading Odisha in rooftop solar panel installation
results.description: Brahmapur: Ganjam has emerged as the leading district in Odisha in the installation of rooftop solar panels under the Centre’s PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, officials said. According to them, Ganjam has recorded the installation of 16,418 rooftop solar projects, followed by Baleswar with 16,407 installations, Khordha with 14,603 units, Kataka with 13,758 units [...]

results.title: Abhishek Sharma eyes IPL, state opportunities for young talent in Sher-e-Punjab T20 League
results.description: Amritsar Soormas captain Abhishek Sharma said helping young teammates earn state and IPL opportunities would be the biggest reward in the Sher-e-Punjab T20 League. He also stressed attacking cricket, self-belief and fearless decision-making while leading his hometown team.
